claims.claim_text: The private identifier printed for Leonard J. Brown resolves to an official Army record for a different person, so the indexed identity remains conflicting.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: Exact identifier comparison produced a different name in the official Army file; the unrelated name and identifier are withheld.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The identifier disagreement is direct official conflict evidence. No Army identity is assigned to Leonard J. Brown.
claims.temporal_assessment: The conflicting Army record cannot establish Leonard J. Brown's chronology, occupation, or employment.
claims.match_notes: The unrelated Army subject is intentionally omitted from the public claim and exports. Same-name directory, military, and cemetery records also lacked Box 85 linkage.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Lewis Q. Brown is confirmed as the Army entrant represented by the exact-name and private-identifier match in the official merged file.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The full name and private service identifier match across the OSS index and official Army-entry file; the identifier is withheld.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by an exact private identifier and exact full indexed name.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army-entry record is dated April 30, 1943; the index documents an OSS personnel file but not the OSS transfer date.
claims.match_notes: The Army entry records private rank PVT and civilian occupation code 091. Same-name candidates lacking the identifier or Box 85 linkage were rejected.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index supplies Kenneth F. Brown and Box 85 but no private identifier, rank, occupation, or other discriminator. Exact-name OSS, CIA, military, employment, obituary, institutional, newspaper, directory, and archival searches did not isolate the indexed person; later and incompatible namesakes were rejected.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 85 for a full middle name, identifier, rank, branch, residence, occupation, employer, and service chronology before assigning any same-name veteran or professional.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked OSS index prints Leonard J. Brown with a private identifier, but exact comparison in the official Army merged file resolves that identifier to a different name. person_updates.next_action: Review Box 85 as a critical identifier-conflict case; determine whether the index contains a transcription error and establish Leonard J. Brown's correct identifier, rank, occupation, employer, and chronology from the personnel file.

research_attempts.query_text: Kenneth F. Brown: visually checked NARA index; CIA and OSS context; exact-name military, employment, occupation, institutional, newspaper, obituary, cemetery, directory, and archival searches.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: A 1928-born Navy veteran, a 1942-born business worker, and later Hawaiian business and architecture namesakes have incompatible chronology or lacked two corroborating identifiers and Box 85 linkage.
research_attempts.research_notes: No reliable identity or pre-OSS employer was established.

research_attempts.rejection_reasons: The exact private identifier resolves to an unrelated Army subject, whose identity is withheld. A 1940 Rochester directory clerk and same-name military or cemetery records lacked the identifier or Box 85 linkage.
research_attempts.research_notes: The direct official identifier conflict is preserved; no Army identity, occupation, or employer is assigned.
research_attempts.next_action: Review Box 85 as a critical identifier-conflict case.
